biggest_catch: No live public personal checking bonus exists on simmonsbank.com — the only current offers are a business-checking bonus gated behind a received promo code (targeted) or a referral-based bonus.
catches: Simmons Bank's last personal checking bonus (up to $450 for online opening with qualifying direct deposits) ran January 26 to March 30, 2026 and is expired.

The current simmonsbank.com offers are: Business Checking up to $900 (opened 8/17/2026–9/30/2026) — but eligibility requires having received a specified promo code by mail, email, or phone, i.e. a targeted offer — and a refer-a-friend program ($50 referral bonus for the new customer, $100 for the referrer), which requires a referral.
No general public $200–$300 personal checking bonus is offered as of 2026-09-23.
